subject: Changing format of numbers in legend in rworldmap

messages.author: ba54d823d40cc3f2
messages.subject: Changing format of numbers in legend in rworldmap
parts:
Hello, I was wondering how to change the numbers in a legend so that they are either percents or not in scientific expression.  Also is it possible to override the range?  For example, the legends defaults to the lowest and highest values, anyway to override this so it is more "clean"?
Thank you,
Matt

messages.author: af271c8777c52f76
messages.subject: Re: [rworldmap group] Changing format of numbers in legend in rworldmap
parts:
Hi Matt,

Please have a look at the rworldmap vignette and also at the manpages:
you should find your way drawing first a map without a lengend
(addLegend = F), and then use the object created by the call to the
mapping function in order to get the proper parameters for the
function addMapLegend, and specify additional parameters to tweak your
legend, for example the options sigFigs and digits. See the help on
addMapLegend.

Example from the vignette:

mapParams <- mapCountryData( sPDF, nameColumnToPlot="BIODIVERSITY",
addLegend=FALSE )
do.call( addMapLegend, c(mapParams, legendWidth=0.5, legendMar = 2))


It will maybe not aoutomatically give you what you want, but maybe you
can also process the data upstream, for instance if you want
percentages you should multiply the data (ratio) by 100 before
proceeding with the map...

Regards,
JB
